title: Check the localization environment
description: You inspect the environment printout and optional NVIDIA command.

steps.description: You define _sh to capture a shell command's output, including standard error. It prints the captured text after the command returns.
You print the Python version, platform, and Colab module check before the NVIDIA heading.

steps.question: What text does the supplied recording show for the NVIDIA command?
steps.answer: The shell reports nvidia-smi: not found. The command includes || true, so that missing command still leads to printing the captured output.

steps.description: You see Python 3.12.16, Linux, and In Colab: False in the recording. The package installation lines remain comments.
